problems.symptom: Rhythm cadence dead: the conductor reads an empty pool file, enqueues to a write-only queue, the gap-closing rhythm is pinned at due 0, and rhythms are lost when the pool resets

problems.symptom: Stores accumulate while the read side is dead: verifier recipes (_useRecipe), decision_outcome, goal_verification_labels, per_gap_failure_lessons, the TARGET HAS NO TEST FILE warning

principles: A fix that enumerates cases inherits a new bug with the next case (08-09 trace-store note)

Never land an audit finding without an adversarial pass; ~90% of confident findings or fixes were wrong or regressions (08-03 cycles 2-3)
Spec → adversarial crosscheck → dispatch; ask which rows a fix touches and whether a policy read can ever resolve (08-06 iter11)
When narrowing admission, enumerate callers across ALL repos (08-04 auth)
Verify a loop is dead by querying the artifact store, not log absence; a failed attempt at closing a gap belongs to that gap (08-02)
Judge a past event by the artifact as of its timestamp (09-12)
Mirrored is not running: watch MainPID/ActiveEnterTimestamp; pull-sync convergence is content-hash, not process identity (09-05, 08-16, 08-28)
Close-rate ≠ landing quality; coax → read the diff → complete (07-29)
on_live_path means 'executes', not 'is the mechanism'; right-law/wrong-site → right-site/wrong-wiring (08-06)
Landing is solved, verification is not: 'not missing information, missing readers' (09-02)

A distribution needs its draw checked, not just its parameters; test moments (08-16)
